title: Constant-time modular exponentiation in an HLS RSA-style kernel
interface: uint32_t modexp(uint32_t base, uint32_t exponent, uint32_t modulus);
expected_output_summary: A single revised inputs/modexp_kernel.cpp implementing the pinned modexp() interface, synthesizable under HLS-style constraints (fixed-size arrays only, no dynamic allocation, no STL containers, no recursion/exceptions/IO), that produces bit-identical results to the reference modular exponentiation for all valid test vectors, and whose internal loop trip count and arithmetic operation schedule are identical across all exponent values for a fixed base and modulus.
